summary: Iteration-2 focused test of the NEW features (Meetings/Calendar, per-agent auto_approve, TR/EN i18n, 3D office) + light regression. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_meetings_autoapprove.py (9 cases) — 9/9 pass: immediate meeting (status active, seat_map 0..5, participants flipped to 'meeting', meeting/start event with seat_map, end -> done + participants back to idle), 6-participant cap, 404s on start/end of unknown id, auth required, scheduler auto-activation of a near-future meeting (~4s tick) and auto-end after duration_seconds (20s) with participants reverted to idle. auto_approve: create AI agent with auto_approve=true persists; assigned task reached status 'completed' directly with real LLM output, NO pending approval, stats.completed +1, agent back to idle; auto_approve OFF agent still went Working->Review + pending approval + status 'waiting'; PUT /api/employees/{id} persists auto_approve both ways. Existing regression suite backend_test.py 28/28 still pass (37/37 total). Frontend (Playwright, real preview URL): TR default on login ('Giriş yap'), sidebar TR nav (Panel/Ofis/Toplantılar), lang-en/lang-tr + settings-lang-en switch works and persists via localStorage alloy_lang across reload; Meetings page: New Meeting modal, 21 participants list with 6-max cap enforced, Start-now default, duration, Create -> row appears AKTIF with 'Bitir', End button moves it to BITTI; scheduled path (start-now off -> datetime input -> PLANLANDI -> 'Şimdi Başlat' -> AKTIF) works; 3D Office renders canvas with 'Meeting Room' label and 6 avatars seated at the meeting table, HUD shows '6 meeting', zero console errors; Agents page: agent-auto-approve toggle in Create dialog and panel-auto-approve toggle persist after reload; Assign & Run on an auto-approve agent bumped Completed 1->2 with no review state. BLOCKER FOUND: /tasks page crashes completely (Uncaught runtime error 't is not a function') — i18n `t` is shadowed by the map/filter callback param `t` in Tasks.jsx.

minor.issue: Due-time check compares ISO strings lexicographically (start_time <= datetime.now(utc).isoformat()). Works only for UTC 'Z'/'+00:00' strings; a start_time with a non-UTC offset (e.g. 2026-07-01T13:00:00+03:00) sorts wrong and activates ~offset-hours late. Parse to datetime (or store an epoch start_ts) and compare numerically.

participants are silently truncated to 6 (body.participants[:6]) with no 422/validation feedback; also participant ids are not validated to exist/belong to the company, so a bogus id is stored and rendered as an empty chip in the UI.
Not idempotent: ending an already 'done' meeting returns 200 and re-emits the 'meeting end' event + 'Meeting ... ended.' activity entry.
Returns {ok:true} for a non-existent id (should be 404); no delete-meeting activity/event either.

Auto-approve path inserts an approvals document with status 'approve' (not 'approved'/'auto_approved'). It shows up in GET /api/approvals with a non-standard status value; the UI filters on 'pending' so it is currently harmless, but the enum is inconsistent.
duration_seconds is not bounded server-side (UI limits 20-600); a huge/negative value is accepted, so end_ts can be in the past (immediate auto-end) or effectively never.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL REGRESSION: whole /tasks page white-screens with 'TypeError: t is not a function'. The i18n translate fn `const { t } = useI18n()` (line 13) is shadowed by the task callback param `t` in `tasks.filter((t) => ...)` (line 68) and `col.map((t) => {...})` (line 77); inside that map, `t("tasks.review")` (line 97) and `t("tasks.running")` (line 102) call a task object. Crashes as soon as any task is in review or working status (always true in the demo company). Rename the callback param to `tk`.
Kanban column headings use a hardcoded English LABEL map (Backlog/Assigned/Working/Review/Completed) — not translated.
Dialog is fully untranslated: title 'Create AI Employee', 'Start from a template', all field labels and the auto-approve helper text stay English in TR mode.
Panel stat labels ('Completed', 'Active', 'Waiting'), the status pill ('Idle') and 'N messages' are hardcoded English while the rest of the panel is Turkish.
Toasts are hardcoded English in TR mode: 'Meeting started — open the Office!', 'Meeting scheduled', 'Started', 'Failed'.
Clicking a 7th participant is silently ignored (no toast/disabled state) — user gets no feedback about the 6-seat cap.
Uses the browser-native <input type="datetime-local"> for scheduling instead of the shadcn calendar/time component used elsewhere in the design system.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify the Kanban/review UI at all because /tasks crashes (see CRITICAL above). Auto-approve completion was verified via the agent panel stats and the API instead.

issues: Activity-feed and notification strings are generated in English on the backend (e.g. 'Task "X" created.', 'Meeting "X" started — participants heading to the room.') so the TR UI shows mixed languages. Consider emitting i18n keys + params instead of prose.
The stray floating neon horizontal bar above the floor reported in iteration_1 is still present (visible green line at the top of the scene).
Office HUD legend is English (Idle/Waiting/Talking/Working/Meeting/Completed) while the header counters are Turkish.
Participant chips show only first names, so seeded duplicates render as 'TEST_Aria, TEST_Aria, TEST_Aria'; no date/time or remaining-duration is displayed for scheduled/active meetings.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix the `t` shadowing in /app/frontend/src/pages/Tasks.jsx (lines 68/77 -> rename callback param; keep t() for i18n). /tasks is currently a hard crash.
Translate Tasks kanban column labels, CreateAgentDialog, agent-panel stat labels and Meetings toasts (i18n gaps).
meeting_scheduler: compare parsed datetimes / epoch instead of ISO strings so non-UTC start_time offsets activate on time.
Validate meeting participants (exist + belong to company, reject >6 with 422) and bound duration_seconds server-side.
Make POST /meetings/{id}/end idempotent and return 404 on DELETE of a missing meeting.
Normalise the auto-approve approvals record status ('approve' -> 'auto_approved') for a consistent enum.
Emit i18n keys (or dual-language) for backend activity/notification text instead of English prose.
Still open from iteration_1: stray floating bars in OfficeScene, approvals double-decision guard, 404s for PUT/DELETE employees, company scoping in deliver_message, server.py size (now 991 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: Tasks.jsx variable shadowing of the i18n `t` is an unguarded crash path — add an ESLint no-shadow rule; every page that destructures `t` must not reuse `t` as a callback param.
server.py is now 991 lines (was 858) — well past the 700-line guideline; meetings + AI runner are good extraction candidates.
meeting_scheduler polls every 4s with two full collection scans and no index on (status, start_time)/(status, end_ts); add indexes or it degrades with meeting volume.

_activate_meeting overwrites employee status unconditionally — an agent actively 'working' on an LLM task is yanked into 'meeting' and reverted to 'idle' when the meeting ends, losing its working state (and run_agent_task later sets it again). Consider skipping/restoring prior status.
Meetings.jsx polls GET /meetings + GET /employees every 3s for all users; consider reusing the existing /events stream instead of duplicate polling.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — all new Meetings/i18n/auto-approve flows pass; /tasks page is a hard crash

rca_of_the_issue: /tasks crash RCA: pages/Tasks.jsx destructures the i18n translator as `t` (line 13) and then reuses `t` as the task element in `tasks.filter((t) => ...)` (line 68) and `col.map((t) => ...)` (line 77). Inside the map body the calls `t("tasks.review")` (line 97, rendered for review-status cards) and `t("tasks.running")` (line 102, working-status cards) invoke a plain task object => 'TypeError: t is not a function', which React escalates to a full-page error boundary/dev overlay. Reproduce: login as demo@alloy.os, ensure at least one task is in review or working (assign a task to a non-auto-approve agent), open /tasks. Fix: rename the callback param (e.g. `tk`) in lines 68/77 and its body references, keeping `t()` for translations.
